consulted_citations.field: PDF p. 77, printed p. 65; 尔 entry; original scan visually inspected
consulted_citations.text: The entry says 尔 is the simplified form of 爾; the construction of early 爾 forms is unclear; and bronze inscriptions use 尔 as a second-person pronoun. It reports examples from the Warring States Zhongshan Wang Ding and describes graphic developments of 尔. This concerns 尔 and does not analyze the formation of 你. I inspected the complete 尔 entry and its glyph sequence in the scan; the OCR excerpt agrees with the visible prose for the claims used.
